## Hi, I'm Summer👋

I came to data science because I realized that any time I got the chance to work with data, 
the work was always fun, and the time would melt away as I wrangled and analyzed the data. 
Data science keeps my interest because it appeals to my need to research, investigate, and understand. 
I love having the opportunity to leverage those skills to help others answer questions. 

At Willamette my focus has been on data engineering and visualizations. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes
together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🌲 I love doing arts and crafts and cuddling my cats!
- 📚 I recently read the Odyssey for the first time and want to keep reading mroe classical literature.
- 🎯 I'd love to be more involved in data governance and planning data engineering pipelines.
